review.title: Review queue
review.subtitle: Subsidiary leads check every submitted plant figure before it reaches the group officer.

approval.title: Approval queue
approval.subtitle: Sustainability officers approve reviewed figures. Approved lines feed the group rollup and the published report.

errors.loadBody: We couldn't reach the server, so we can't confirm what is waiting for you. Nothing has been changed.
errors.needComment_review: Add a comment so the contributor knows what to fix.
errors.needComment_approval: Add a comment so the reviewer knows what to recheck.
errors.needCommentReject: Add a comment explaining why this is rejected.

empty.review: No plant submissions are waiting for a lead to review. New submissions appear here as contributors send them.
empty.approval: Nothing is awaiting approval from the sustainability officer. Reviewed figures appear here as leads pass them on.

cleared.title: Queue cleared
cleared.body_review_one: You passed {{count}} figure to approval. New submissions will appear here.
cleared.body_review_other: You passed {{count}} figures to approval. New submissions will appear here.
cleared.body_approval_one: You approved {{count}} figure. It now feeds the group rollup and the report.
cleared.body_approval_other: You approved {{count}} figures. They now feed the group rollup and the report.

detail.noEvidence: No evidence attached. Ask for a source document before approving.
detail.commentPlaceholder_review: Comment — optional to pass, required to send back
detail.commentPlaceholder_approval: Comment — optional to approve, required to return or reject
